accept.criterion: A room with the tictactoe fixture plays a full playlist of 2 games using 2 bot clients
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server apps/server/test/room.test.ts -t "plays a full playlist of 2 games using 2 bot clients"
accept.evidence: real RoomManager + room actor on a fake clock: two scripted clients play two tictactoe games from a fixed playlist through intro, game, results and scoreboard to ended

accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server apps/server/test/room.test.ts apps/server/test/room-units.test.ts -t "Scoreboard shows placement points|placement points 10/7/5/3/2/1|raw scoring|team rows award"
accept.evidence: room snapshot standings carry 10/7/... placement points after a game; unit tests cover the 10/7/5/3/2/1-then-1 table, shared ties, raw scoring, team rows and the record round-trip

accept.criterion: Killing a client's socket mid-turn leads to bot takeover after the grace period
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server apps/server/test/room.test.ts -t "bot takeover after the grace period|reconnecting participant takes the seat back|abandoned seat is released"
accept.evidence: the socket of the player to move is closed; nothing happens during reconnectGraceSec, then the module's bot plays the seat; a reconnect takes the seat back; an abandoned seat is released when the game ends

accept.criterion: With 1 audience member and 1,000 audience members, the server calls view() for the audience the same number of times: once per step
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server apps/server/test/room.test.ts apps/server/test/room-units.test.ts -t "1,000 audience members|coalesce into one frame per key"
accept.evidence: counts audience view() calls over the same scripted game with 1 and 1,000 audience sockets (equal); the audience frame is one topic publish; several steps in one turn produce one frame per viewer key

accept.criterion: 9 seated players and a 4-seat game: exactly 4 participants, the 5 benched players are guaranteed seats in the next game with room, and benched players get no placement points
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server apps/server/test/room.test.ts apps/server/test/room-units.test.ts -t "9 seated players and a 4-seat game|participants: host-benched sit out"
accept.evidence: 4 participants, 5 benched (audience role, flagged benched in the snapshot, acts refused NOT_ALLOWED, absent from standings); the next 8-seat game includes all 5; pickParticipants unit test covers priority and overflow

accept.criterion: raffle 3 with a queue of 50 picks 3 distinct members, deterministic for a fixed seed
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server apps/server/test/room.test.ts apps/server/test/room-units.test.ts -t "raffle 3 with a queue of 50|raffle and queue fill"
accept.evidence: two rooms with the same seed and a 50-member queue raffle the same 3 distinct members, seated at the next game boundary; a different seed differs

accept.criterion: The next-game vote picks the plurality candidate; with 2 voters (below audienceMin) the playlist order is used
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server apps/server/test/room.test.ts apps/server/test/room-units.test.ts -t "next-game vote picks the plurality candidate|with 2 voters|next-game vote takes the plurality"
accept.evidence: audience-vote playlist: 3 unplayed candidates, 15 s poll; plurality wins with enough voters; 2 voters fall back to playlist order; ties and zero votes unit-tested

accept.criterion: Pausing for 30 s and resuming leaves the remaining input time unchanged (±50 ms)
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server apps/server/test/room.test.ts -t "pausing for 30 s and resuming|pause freezes the intro card"
accept.evidence: the runner's input deadline minus now is measured before pause and after a 30 s BRB and resume: equal within 50 ms; the intro card timer also freezes

accept.criterion: A Stage socket never receives a frame containing a host-view-only field (frame grep test)
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server apps/server/test/room.test.ts -t "Stage socket never receives a frame"
accept.evidence: every frame the host's Stage socket receives during a game with moderation is grepped for the fixture's host-only marker and for modq: none; the host-panel socket does receive them

accept.criterion: Behaviour: host commands, forceAdvance, fillBots/bench, review-wait timeout, snapshots every 20 actions or 10 s, stream/streamEach/private effects, patch vs full view
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server apps/server/test/room.test.ts apps/server/test/room-units.test.ts
accept.evidence: room actor lifecycle, moderation, snapshots/restore, anti-snipe and fan-out unit tests (patch with seq, full view above 60%, binary frames routing)
